quotations.old_english: Búton ðam ceorle ðe on gafollande sit, and heora [the Danes] liésingum [lýsingum]; ða syndan efendýre, ǽgðer tó cc. sci&l-bar;&l-bar;.

source_text: lísing, es; m. A freedman :-- Lísingas and þeówe, Chart. Th. 592, 1. Búton ðam ceorle ðe on gafollande sit, and heora [the Danes] liésingum [lýsingum]; ða syndan efendýre, ǽgðer tó cc. sci&l-bar;&l-bar;., L. A. G. 2; Th. i. 154, 3. [Icel. leysingi, leysingr a freedman.]
